background: NatWest Group is the holding company of the UK's largest business bank, owner of NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland, Ulster Bank and Coutts, returned to full private ownership after its financial-crisis rescue.
synthesis: Ratings are A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 10 Sep 2025. Capital is on the weak side of UK majors, CET1 of 13.2% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 4.7% below the median, while liquidity is mixed, LCR of 140% below the median against NSFR of 132% above it. LCR has fallen 10 points since 30 Jun 2025 with the rest broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). Flagged items are dominated by results, with higher returns and upgraded guidance through the summer; the newest, on 25 Sep 2026, is a customer product launch carrying no credit content.
